jobs.title: Security Engineer, Corporate Security
jobs.experience: 5+ years mentioned (check advert)
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.

Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.

ABOUT US:

Notion helps you build beautiful tools for your life’s work. In today's world of endless apps and tabs, Notion provides one place for teams to get everything done, seamlessly connecting docs, notes, projects, calendar, and email—with AI built in to find answers and automate work. Millions of users, from individuals to large organizations like Toyota, Figma, and OpenAI, love Notion for its flexibility and choose it because it helps them save time and money.

 

In-person collaboration is essential to Notion's culture. We require all team members to work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays, our designated Anchor Days. Certain teams or positions may require additional in-office workdays.

 

ABOUT THE ROLE:

Millions of people rely on Notion to do their most important work. Protecting that trust starts with protecting the people who build Notion: our employees, their laptops, their identities, and the SaaS apps they rely on every day.

We are looking for a hands-on Corporate Security Engineer to own and improve the technical controls that keep our workforce and corporate environment safe. This is a security engineering role focused on building scalable controls and automation across identity, endpoints, SaaS, and workforce infrastructure, not a traditional IT support or corporate engineering role.

You'll own and evolve core security controls, design systems and automation that scale with the company, and help make security both stronger and easier to use. You'll partner closely with IT, Infrastructure, GRC, and Detection & Response to improve the security foundations that employees rely on every day.

 

WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Harden our identity and access management stack, including Okta and Google Workspace, with phishing-resistant MFA, strong SSO and SCIM lifecycles, and least-privilege access across SaaS.

 - Run our endpoint security program across a macOS-first fleet, including MDM, EDR, and configuration baselines, with working coverage for Windows and ChromeOS.

 - Secure AI tool usage at the endpoint, including governance of large language models, AI agents, and model context protocol (MCP) integrations; detect and prevent unauthorized or risky AI service access and data exfiltration through AI-enabled tools.

 - Reduce SaaS risk at scale through SSPM tooling and custom automation, including detection of risky OAuth grants, excessive permissions, shadow IT, and configuration drift.

 - Write code (Python, Terraform) to automate access reviews, onboarding and offboarding, configuration drift detection, and audit evidence collection.

 - Partner with Detection & Response to ensure corporate systems produce the telemetry needed to detect identity, endpoint, and SaaS abuse.

 - Support SOC 2, ISO 27001, and customer audits as a byproduct of good engineering, not a separate workstream.

 - Partner with Detection & Response on investigation and response for corporate security incidents, including phishing, account compromise, lost devices, and BEC.

 

SKILLS YOU NEED TO BRING:

 - Have 5+ years of hands-on experience in corporate security, enterprise security, or IT security engineering at a cloud-native company.

 - Have working knowledge of a major identity provider (Okta, Entra, or Google Workspace) and the underlying protocols (SAML, OIDC, OAuth 2.0, SCIM).

 - Have hands-on experience operating endpoint management and detection tooling across macOS and enterprise environments.

 - Write production-quality scripts and automation in Python or Bash, and have shipped Terraform or other infrastructure-as-code for security configuration.

 - Are familiar with SaaS security risks (OAuth governance, audit logging, SSPM) and the realities of integrating a long tail of vendors.

 - Have working knowledge of at least one major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure) at the security configuration level.

 - Communicate clearly in writing and work effectively across IT, Engineering, Legal, People, and GRC.

NICE TO HAVES:

 - Experience at a fast-growing tech or AI company where the security program had to outpace headcount.

 - A background in IT engineering, SRE, or production engineering that transitioned into security engineering.

 - Experience building internal security tooling or workflows that improved employee or developer experience.

 - Contributions to the security community through open-source tools, blog posts, or conference talks.

 

We hire talented and passionate people from a variety of backgrounds because we want our global employee base to represent the wide diversity of our customers. If you’re excited about a role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every bullet point listed in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. If you’re a builder at heart, share our company values, and enthusiastic about making software toolmaking ubiquitous, we want to hear from you.

 

Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin,

jobs.title: GTM Systems Administrator, EMEA
jobs.experience: 8+ years mentioned (check advert)
jobs.description:
WHY HARVEY

At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.

This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.

Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.

At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

ROLE OVERVIEW

Harvey is building a best-in-class go-to-market engine, and we're looking for a GTM Systems Administrator to join the GTM Systems team and help scale the systems that power both our pipeline and our customer experience. You'll take on a variety of projects across the full GTM lifecycle, from how we source, enrich, and route leads at the top of the funnel to how we support and engage customers through Zendesk and our Customer Success platforms. This is not a traditional RevOps or Salesforce admin role: we expect this person to work AI-first, using AI tools and agents to build, automate, and maintain systems that would traditionally require engineering support or manual admin work. Reporting to the Head of GTM Systems, you'll partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Support, and Customer Success to translate business needs into scalable, reliable systems that directly drive revenue and retention outcomes.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Work across a variety of projects on the GTM Systems team, with some sprints focused on top-of-funnel growth and others on support and customer success tooling, flexing to where the business needs you most.

 - Design and improve top-of-funnel systems including lead sourcing, enrichment, scoring, and routing, building enrichment workflows in Clay and across data providers (ZoomInfo, Cognism, Apollo, Clearbit, etc.) to power inbound and outbound pipeline.

 - Configure and optimize Zendesk as Harvey's primary support platform (ticket routing, triggers, automations, macros, SLA policies, agent workspace) and support adjacent CS platforms like Catalyst.

 - Contribute to Salesforce configuration across the funnel, including lead routing, scoring, lifecycle stages, and automation (Flows, validation rules, custom objects), and how data flows across Salesforce, marketing automation, support, and enrichment tools.

 - Use AI as a default working method: build and maintain AI agents, automations, and workflows (AI triage, copilots, agent-based enrichment, LLM-powered data quality checks) to eliminate manual admin work and extend what the systems team can ship without engineering support.

 - Integrate GTM and CS tools with Harvey's broader ecosystem (CRM, product data, internal tools, communication platforms) to ensure a unified view of the customer, and build reporting and dashboards that provide visibility into pipeline conversion, support performance, and customer health.

 - Maintain high data quality and compliance through deduplication, normalization, enrichment governance, and consent/opt-out handling, and document system architecture, workflows, and processes so everything scales as the company grows.

WHAT YOU HAVE

 - 4-8+ years of experience in GTM Systems, RevOps, Growth Ops, Support Ops, or similar roles.

 - Strong proficiency in Salesforce (data modeling, Flows, lead routing, account hierarchy, reporting) plus hands-on experience administering Zendesk (routing, automations, triggers, SLA policies), or deep expertise in one with proven ability to ramp fast on the other.

 - Hands-on experience with Clay and at least one major enrichment/data provider (ZoomInfo, Cognism, Apollo, Clearbit, etc.), and experience with marketing automation platforms (Marketo, HubSpot, or similar).

 - Demonstrated AI fluency: you already use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Clay AI, Zendesk AI, or similar) to build workflows, automate admin tasks, draft configurations, and troubleshoot, and you can point to concrete things you've shipped this way.

 - Strong systems thinking, with the ability to design and debug end-to-end data flows across tools, spanning both reactive support workflows and proactive growth motions.

 - A collaborative, team-first working style: comfortable operating in a pod, picking up varied projects, and working cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Support, Customer Success, and Operations. Highly organized and documentation-oriented, with a focus on scalable, maintainable systems.

BONUS

 - Experience with Customer Success platforms (Gainsight, Catalyst) or Zendesk certification(s).

 - Experience building integrations using APIs, webhooks, or iPaaS tools (Workato, Zapier, MuleSoft), or integrating GTM systems with data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery).

 - Experience building or deploying AI agents in production (e.g., agentic prospecting, AI ticket triage, health-score automation)

 - Working knowledge of SQL and/or scripting (Python, JavaScript) for data workflows.

 - Background in high-growth or early-stage environments where systems are built from the ground up.

DEPENDING ON YOUR LOCATION, AN APPLICANT PRIVACY NOTICE MAY APPLY TO YOU. YOU CAN FIND ALL OF OUR APPLICANT PRIVACY NOTICES HERE https://harveyai.notion.site/Harvey-Candidate-Pr

Reporting to the Head of GTM Systems, you'll partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Support, and Customer Success to translate business needs into scalable, reliable systems that directly drive revenue and retention outcomes.







WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Work across a variety of projects on the GTM Systems team, with some sprints focused on top-of-funnel growth and others on support and customer success tooling, flexing to where the business needs you most.

 - Design and improve top-of-funnel systems including lead sourcing, enrichment, scoring, and routing, building enrichment workflows in Clay and across data providers (ZoomInfo, Cognism, Apollo, Clearbit, etc.) to power inbound and outbound pipeline.

 - Configure and optimize Zendesk as Harvey's primary support platform (ticket routing, triggers, automations, macros, SLA policies, agent workspace) and support adjacent CS platforms like Catalyst.

 - Contribute to Salesforce configuration across the funnel, including lead routing, scoring, lifecycle stages, and automation (Flows, validation rules, custom objects), and how data flows across Salesforce, marketing automation, support, and enrichment tools.

 - Use AI as a default working method: build and maintain AI agents, automations, and workflows (AI triage, copilots, agent-based enrichment, LLM-powered data quality checks) to eliminate manual admin work and extend what the systems team can ship without engineering support.

 - Integrate GTM and CS tools with Harvey's broader ecosystem (CRM, product data, internal tools, communication platforms) to ensure a unified view of the customer, and build reporting and dashboards that provide visibility into pipeline conversion, support performance, and customer health.

 - Maintain high data quality and compliance through deduplication, normalization, enrichment governance, and consent/opt-out handling, and document system architecture, workflows, and processes so everything scales as the company grows.



WHAT YOU HAVE

 - 4-8+ years of experience in GTM Systems, RevOps, Growth Ops, Support Ops, or similar roles.

 - Strong proficiency in Salesforce (data modeling, Flows, lead routing, account hierarchy, reporting) plus hands-on experience administering Zendesk (routing, automations, triggers, SLA policies), or deep expertise in one with proven ability to ramp fast on the other.

 - Hands-on experience with Clay and at least one major enrichment/data provider (ZoomInfo, Cognism, Apollo, Clearbit, etc.), and experience with marketing automation platforms (Marketo, HubSpot, or similar).

 - Demonstrated AI fluency: you already use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Clay AI, Zendesk AI, or similar) to build workflows, automate admin tasks, draft configurations, and troubleshoot, and you can point to concrete things you've shipped this way.

 - Strong systems thinking, with the ability to design and debug end-to-end data flows across tools, spanning both reactive support workflows and proactive growth motions.

 - A collaborative, team-first working style: comfortable operating in a pod, picking up varied projects, and working cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Support, Customer Success, and Operations. Highly organized and documentation-oriented, with a focus on scalable, maintainable systems.


BONUS

 - Experience with Customer Success platforms (Gainsight, Catalyst) or Zendesk certification(s).

 - Experience building integrations using APIs, webhooks, or iPaaS tools (Workato, Zapier, MuleSoft), or integrating GTM systems with data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery).

 - Experience building or deploying AI agents in production (e.g., agentic prospecting, AI ticket triage, health-score automation)

 - Working knowledge of SQL and/or scripting (Python, JavaScript) for data workflows.

 - Background in high-growth or early-stage environments where systems are built from the ground up.

jobs.description:
About the Team

OpenAI Finance is responsible for ensuring the organization is set up for success in pursuit of its mission.

OpenAI’s Payroll team is responsible for timely and accurate processing of payroll and ensuring compliance with all statutory regulations.

About the Role

At OpenAI, payroll is not a back-office function — it is mission-critical infrastructure. We are seeking a seasoned International Payroll lead to scale and continuously improve the global payroll and payroll-support ecosystem that serves one of the fastest-growing and most technically sophisticated organizations in the world.

This role is based in our Dublin, Ireland office. We use a hybrid work model of 3 days in the office per week and offer relocation assistance to new employees.

In this role, you will:

 - Lead the international payroll processing team and oversee end-to-end payroll delivery across EMEA and APAC, ensuring employees are paid accurately, on time, and in compliance with local requirements.

 - Own day-to-day operations with outsourced payroll and BPO partners, including payroll calendars, inputs, reconciliations, service-level performance, quality standards, issue resolution, and escalations.

 - Lead the payroll workstream for global expansion and new-country launches, including payroll registrations, in-country vendor setup, implementation, testing, systems integration, and go-live readiness.

 - Partner with People, Finance, Tax, Legal, Benefits, Equity, and Treasury teams to ensure accurate upstream inputs, funding, accounting, and downstream reporting.

 - Draft and maintain payroll documentation, process maps, operating procedures, and internal controls to support compliance, audit readiness, and business continuity.

 - Proactively identify and resolve payroll discrepancies and employee inquiries within SLAs, determine root causes, and implement controls that prevent recurrence.

 - Use data, automation, and AI-enabled tools to improve controls, reduce manual work, and increase the scalability and effectiveness of international payroll operations.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

 - 6+ years of progressive experience in international payroll operations, preferably in a fast-paced or high-growth environment.

 - Demonstrated experience leading multi-country payroll delivery across EMEA and APAC, including management of outsourced payroll or BPO providers.

 - Hands-on experience supporting new-country payroll implementations, vendor onboarding, testing, and systems integrations.

 - Hands-on experience using AI tools to enhance, automate, and strengthen payroll workflows and controls.

 - Strong working knowledge of international payroll regulations, tax withholding, social insurance, statutory reporting, and standard payroll practices.

 - Hands-on experience with Workday HCM and global payroll systems.

 - Ability to independently manage priorities, take ownership of outcomes, and deliver high-quality work under tight deadlines.

 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail.

 - Clear and concise communication skills, with the ability to partner effectively with internal and external stakeholders.

 - Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, HR, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

We’re looking for Senior+ AI Infrastructure Engineers to build the systems that train and serve Fin's next generation of AI products.

You’ll join a small, highly technical team working at the cutting edge of modern AI infrastructure. The AI Infra team built the training pipelines and runs the inference for custom models like Fin Apex, which outperforms frontier models in customer service tasks, and is the foundation of the AI Group's full stack approach to AI.

We’re particularly interested in engineers who have:

• A track record of working on model training or model inference at scale, or on low‑level GPU coding (e.g. CUDA, Triton). Experience with one is great, multiple is even better.

• Collaborate closely with ML scientists to implement cutting edge training and inference methods and bring them to production.

• Play an active role in hiring, mentoring, and developing other engineers on the team.

• Raise the bar for technical standards, reliability, and operational excellence across Fin's AI platform.

These are indicative, not hard requirements

We’re looking to hire Senior+ AI Infrastructure Engineers. You’re likely a great fit if:

• You have 5+ years of experience in software engineering, with a strong track record of shipping high‑quality products or platforms.

• You hold a degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field (or you have equivalent experience with very strong fundamentals).

• You have hands‑on experience with one or more of the following:

• Model training (especially transformers and LLMs).

• Model inference at scale (again, especially transformers and LLMs).

• Low‑level GPU work, such as writing CUDA or Triton kernels.

• Comfortable working in production environments at meaningful scale (traffic, data, or organizational).

• You communicate clearly, can explain complex technical topics to different audiences, and enjoy close collaboration with both engineers and non‑engineers.

• You take pride in strong technical fundamentals, love learning, and are willing to invest in your own development.

• Have deep knowledge of at least one programming language (for example Python, Ruby, Java, Go, etc.). Specific language experience is less important than your ability to write clean, reliable code and learn new stacks quickly.

jobs.description:
Role Overview

This is a hybrid role, with an expectation to be on site at least 2 days per week in our Cork office.

NETGEAR creates innovative networking solutions for homes and businesses around the world. We're looking for a Senior Microsoft 365 & Identity Engineer, to own our Microsoft 365, identity and device management platforms globally. This role reports to the Director, Cloud and Enablement, and sits within NETGEAR’s global IT team.

This is a senior, hands-on individual contributor role with global scope. You'll drive M365 and Entra ID projects, act as the technical authority for the platform, and mentor peers across IT. You'll keep identity and devices secure, improve the experience for users across the Americas, EMEA and APAC, and work closely with Microsoft and teams across NETGEAR. It's a high-ownership role on a global team.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Own the architecture and administration of Microsoft 365 end to end, including Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Microsoft 365 Apps and Intune, from governance through to user experience.

 - Act as the technical authority for identity and access across Active Directory and Entra ID, including hybrid identity, SSO, conditional access, MFA and the joiner, mover and leaver lifecycle.

 - Own device management and servicing for Windows, mobile and Microsoft 365 Apps, with a focus on reliability and minimal user disruption.

 - Strengthen our security and compliance posture across identity, access, data and devices, in partnership with Corporate Security.

 - Rationalise overlapping tools and adopt native Microsoft 365 capabilities where it makes sense, optimising licensing and cost.

 - Automate administration and reporting using PowerShell.

 - Manage the strategic technical relationship with Microsoft, making full use of available programs, assessments and expertise.

 - Partner with Corporate Security, Engineering and IT teams globally, and maintain clear documentation and standards.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - 8+ years administering Microsoft 365 in an enterprise environment.

 - Expertise in Active Directory and Entra ID, including hybrid identity, conditional access and MFA.

 - Hands-on experience with Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive and Intune.

 - Strong PowerShell scripting and automation skills.

 - Strong communication skills.

 - Bachelor’s degree (NFQ Level 8) in a relevant discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
   
   

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Microsoft certifications, for example MS-102, SC-300 or MD-102.

 - Experience with Microsoft Defender, Purview or Microsoft Graph.

 - Experience in a global technology company supporting a global user base across time zones.

 - Experience working directly with Microsoft account, support or partner teams.

Eligibility to live and work in Ireland is required. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship or relocation support for this role. 

Company Statement

At NETGEAR, we are on a mission to unleash the full potential of connectivity with intelligent solutions that delight and protect. We turn ideas into innovative networking products that connect people, power businesses, and advance the way we live.  

We're a performance-driven, talented and connected team that's committed to delivering world-class products for our customers. As a company, we value our employees as the most essential building blocks of our success. And as teammates, we commit to taking our work to the Next Gear by living our values: we Dare to Transform the future, Connect and Delight our customers, Communicate Courageously with each other and collaborate to Win It Together. You’ll find our values woven through our processes, present in our decisions, and celebrated throughout our culture. 

We strive to attract top talent and create a great workplace where people feel engaged, inspired, challenged, proud and respected. If you are creative, forward-thinking, passionate about technology and are looking for a rewarding career to make an impact, then you've got what it takes to succeed at NETGEAR. Join our network and help us shape the future of connectivity. 

NETGEAR hires based on merit. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Abuse Operations is the front-line incident response and remediation function handling active product abuse and fraud impacting Stripe and its merchants. This multi-disciplinary group, spanning Incident Managers, Investigators, Forward Deployed Security Engineers, and Data Scientists, neutralizes active attacks, gathers requirements for operational tooling, and leads incidents. The team works directly with impacted merchants to resolve incidents and policy abuse rapidly. Operating primarily across Eastern, Pacific and Western European time zones, these team members regularly coordinate with global stakeholders across the world.

What you’ll do

In this role, you will play a critical part in safeguarding our financial ecosystem through two main pillars: actively responding to live fraud and abuse incidents as a hands-on security engineer, and serving as a key bridge between incidents and merchants to help them remediate threats, improve security posture, and protect their accounts. Leveraging your technical depth in fraud, abuse, and security engineering, you will investigate high-risk accounts, perform post-incident analyses, gather operational requirements, and drive agentic response capabilities ensuring we neutralize threats with speed and precision while elevating Stripe's product integrity function.

Responsibilities

• Respond to live fraud and abuse incidents as a Forward Deployed Security Engineer, investigating high-risk activity, neutralizing active attacks, and mitigating security risks across the ecosystem.

• Investigate, mitigate, and remediate urgent fraud incidents (e.g., ATO, card testing), utilizing FT3-mapped  (Fraud Taxonomy 3.0) detection and signals enrichment to reduce uncertainty and accelerate response.

• As part of incidents, analyze high-risk accounts to identify fraudulent merchants, card testing, account takeovers, and other fraud vectors, classifying them using FT3 to standardize threat intelligence.

• Develop, document, and execute incident response strategies, runbooks, and capabilities to continuously improve fraud and abuse detection and prevention.

• Act as a dedicated technical bridge during and after incidents to work directly with impacted merchants and customers, helping them investigate root causes, remediate vulnerabilities, and secure their accounts.

• Serve as an operational and technical liaison for legal teams, policy partners, and threat intelligence communities.

• Build and nurture strong strategic relationships across external threat intelligence communities, peer working groups, and law enforcement agencies.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• 10+ years of experience leading security or fraud incident response; 

• B.S./M.S. in Computer Science or equivalent experience.

• Expert knowledge of Python and SQL, and familiarity with other programming languages

• Existing experience with log analysis (e.g. first or third party applications, system / data access, event logs), network security, digital forensics, and incident response investigations

• Proven ability to build automated response workflows, leverage threat intelligence, and make risk mitigation recommendations.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills with a track record of driving cross-functional alignment with minimal oversight.

• Previous work with law enforcement

• Engagement in threat intelligence sharing communities

Preferred qualifications

• Broad expertise across fraud and abuse mitigation, risk management, product trust, and threat intelligence in a complex platform environment.

• An adversarial mindset, understanding the goals, behaviors, and TTPs of threat actors.

• Experience with engineering, data processing and analysis tools (e.g. Databricks, Trino, etc.)

• Familiarity with common open-source frameworks for big data processing and/or data science (PySpark, Pandas, Sci-kit Learn, etc.)

• Experience with tactical threat intelligence and/or hunting for sophisticated threat actors in an enterprise environment

• Ability to proactively challenge the status quo by leveraging data and taking a user-centric approach to address complex product integrity challenges.

jobs.description:
From Fivetran’s founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We’re proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data-driven.

About Us

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.

Together, we’re delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.

As we bring our teams and technology together, we’re building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It’s an exciting time to join us: we’re creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

About the Role

Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.

We’re looking for a talented German speaking Senior Sales Engineer to join our Enterprise sales team. As an Enterprise Sales Engineer, you will work closely with our sales team to understand our Enterprise customers’ complex business needs and showcase how Fivetran’s data replication solutions can help them achieve their desired business outcomes. You will be responsible for providing technical expertise, identifying technical requirements, and ensuring a successful proof-of value throughout the sales cycle.

This is a full-time remote position based out of Ireland.

Technologies You’ll Use

AWS, GCP, Azure, Snowflake, BigQuery, Databricks, New Relic, Linux, Windows, Python, Java

What You’ll Do

• Work with Enterprise customers to understand their business, their use cases, and their data replication requirements

• Develop and deliver technical presentations to Enterprise audiences

• Ensure the technical win by running an organized proof-of-value process

• Work closely with multiple cross-fuctional organizations driving change and improvements to Fivetran as a whole.

• Work closely with multiple Sales representatives, while maintaining a high level of customer focus and technical excellence

•

jobs.experience: Not stated in available listing data
jobs.description:
Qumulo’s cloud data platform manages exabytes of the world’s most demanding data, unifying files, objects, and every workload across edge, core, and cloud.

About the Senior Salesforce Administrator (GTM) position:

In this role you’ll own Salesforce for Qumulo’s global Go-To-Market organization - every lead, quote, order, and renewal runs through your platform. Your focus is to keep it clean, make it easy to use, and actively work shape it around how the business sells to reduce friction and improve outcomes across the board. 

This is a highly visible role with real ownership. Salesforce and other GTM systems are yours to run and improve, and you’ll have a say in how the entire GTM tech stack comes together. The changes you make will improve our end-to-end sales process: from how quickly quotes become bookings to how much time sellers get back for other tasks.  Reporting to our Senior Manager of Sales Technology, you'll work directly with Sales, Finance, Marketing, and Customer Success to build and configure the systems that allow their teams to work effectively and efficiently. 

This role is based in our Cork city-center office, alongside world-class engineering and commercial teams. Reflecting the caliber of this role, we're offering a strong salary and benefits package, including pre-IPO stock options, a flexible schedule, and a home internet allowance.

What you’ll do:

 - Own Salesforce administration across Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Revenue Cloud/CPQ, and Experience Cloud.

 - Partner with sales, marketing, and customer success leaders to shape Salesforce around how their teams work.

 - Restructure our processed as the business changes, and own the data quality rules that keep it clean.

 - Run intake for sales technology requests. Help decide what we build, buy, or retire.

 - Lead GTM systems projects, such as new platform rollouts and product introductions.

 - Write the specs and user stories behind each change, then test them with the people who asked.

 - Automate manual work for sellers, leveraging AI tools to find the best way to build it.

 - Define integration requirements with our engineering and data teams.

 - Support lead-to-cash in Salesforce. When the numbers disagree with NetSuite, find out why.

 - Run the GTM support queue and manage releases with IT, including user training.

What we’re looking for:

 - You’ve been a hands-on Salesforce admin for 5+ years at a B2B company, and you hold the Salesforce Administrator certification.

 - Sales Cloud and CPQ or Revenue Cloud are platforms you’ve run in production.

 - You’ve led an enterprise systems implementation, or played a major part in one - ideally you’ve replatformed or restructured a Salesforce org.

 - You already use AI at work, and you can show us something you built with it.

 - You know APIs well enough to spec an integration and troubleshoot it when it fails.

 - You can keep regular hours that overlap with our US team.

 - Bonus if you build in Flow or have shipped an AI agent to production, know NetSuite, write SQL or Python, hold Advanced Admin or CPQ certification, and/or have worked for a company that sells through channel partners.

This is a hybrid role (3 days per week) based out of our Cork office. The annual pay range for the role is EUR €90,000 - €130,000 plus benefits and pre-IPO stock options. Individual pay depends on various factors, such as role level, relevant experience, and skills.

Qumulo opened its European R&D hub in Cork in March 2026. The team here works the way the whole company does: we act as owners and share by default. You’ll work alongside the engineers and commercial teams whose work runs through your systems.

About Qumulo:
Built for the most demanding enterprise workloads, from AI and HPC simulations to Splunk Observability, genomics and PACS medical imaging, geospatial datasets, media editing and rendering, and video surveillance, Qumulo unlocks the full power of an organization’s information. Our platform unifies file and object storage across data centers, edge, and public clouds, enabling efficient, accelerated computing and extending the reach of data unbound by protocol or transport limitations.

With more than 1,100 customers and exabytes of data under management, Qumulo powers mission-critical workloads anywhere real-time access to massive file datasets is non-negotiable. Qumulo delivers radical simplicity, hardware freedom, exceptional customer support, and a true hybrid-cloud architecture.

Our Values: 
At Qumulo, we are building an open and collaborative culture where people can do their best work with customers as our magnetic field. We act as owners, we share by default, we are data driven and experimental and as an inclusive workplace, we encourage and celebrate multiple points of view. As part of our culture we believe diversity drives innovation.

Equal Opportunity Employer:
Qumulo is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, military status, national origin, or any other characteristic protected under federal, state, or applicable local law. For more information on Qumulo's Applicant Privacy Policy, please visit: https://qumulo.com/applicant-employee-privacy-notice

GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

An overview of this role

You will lead efforts to design, position, and close outcome-oriented professional services engagements that translate complex DevSecOps and digital transformation initiatives into clear, measurable mission-critical outcomes. 

Reporting to the Senior Manager of Engagement Management, EMEA, you will work at the intersection of technical solutioning and customer requirements, aligning each engagement to their unique needs and objectives.  In your first year, you will build trusted advisor relationships with technical leaders and partners to help integrate professional services into account strategies from early discovery through successful delivery. This is a unique opportunity to shape large-scale implementations that improve how customers plan, build, secure, and operate software using GitLab.

Some examples of our projects

jobs.experience: Not stated in available listing data
jobs.description:
Role Description

We are looking for a data-driven, systems-thinking Sales Operations Manager to own the operating infrastructure that powers our go-to-market engine. In this highly visible Individual Contributor role, you will serve as the backbone of a regional Sales organization and translate go-to-market strategy into an executable operating model.

You will act as the primary regional business partner for sales executives, supporting all routes to market within the region. You will own or coordinate supporting sales planning, territory and quota execution, forecast interpretation, operational improvements, and translation of strategic priorities into clear execution plans.

 

You’ll drive process clarity, pipeline health, forecasting hygiene, and cross-functional governance, using AI and automation-enabled workflows to reduce manual reporting effort while maintaining strong human judgment over business recommendations. Your top priority each day will be to ensure excellence in execution and reporting on our regional goals. 

Responsibilities

• Own the operating cadence, including territory management, account segmentation, forecasting governance, pipeline inspection, business reviews, and performance visibility, delivering executive-ready insights that drive forecast accuracy, balanced sales coverage, and operational excellence.Partner with regional Sales leaders across all routes to market to improve forecast accuracy, pipeline health, sales coverage, deal quality, and operational execution.

• Work in close partnership with the Chief Business Officer’s organization and the GTM Strategy & Programs team to connect regional Sales Operations to company-wide priorities, provide timely inputs for executive reporting, and ensure consistency across regional and corporate operating cadences.

• Lead end-to-end coverage design, including segmentation, book cutting, territory planning, account assignment, capacity planning, and quota allocation in partnership with Sales Leadership, Compensation, Finance, Systems, and Analytics.

• Own CRM QA and hygiene for the supported region, including SFDC hierarchy management, pipeline quality, process compliance, forecast integrity, deal quality investigations, and exception resolution.

• Partner with leadership on pipeline inspection, forecasting, and opportunity assessment, and build executive-ready reporting, dashboards, MBR/QBR readouts, and business insights that help leaders identify risks and make better decisions.

• Partner with Sales Strategy, Systems, Analytics, Compensation, Finance, and Enablement to automate recurring workflows and continuously improve how the team operates.

• Support organization design, interim coverage plans, role changes, new-hire onboarding, SPIF development and administration, and Channel deal registration as part of the regional operating model.

jobs.description:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.

Global Portfolio & Marketing Manager, PWS New Ventures 

On-site

Cork, Ireland or Lausanne, Switzerland

The Role 

As the Global Portfolio & Marketing Manager for New Ventures, PWS Business Group, you will play a central role in building and scaling new categories.

This role will drive global B2B & B2C portfolio and marketing strategy development and transform the assigned category by identifying portfolio gaps and growth opportunities, defining high-impact go-to-market strategies and new launch models, and creating effective marketing programs that drive growth.

Reporting to the Head of Business & Marketing for PWS New Ventures, this role requires being on-site 3 days a week as standard and flexibility to travel up to 20% of the time.

Your Impact 

Be Yourself. Be Open. Stay Hungry and Humble. Collaborate. Challenge. Decide and just Do. These are the behaviors you'll need for success at Logitech. 

In this role you will:

• Lead new product development and launch from the Portfolio and Marketing side, including business case development and end-to-end commercial launch readiness
• Develop new GTM models, GTM plans, and sales enablement tools for bringing products to the market with maximum impact in B2B and B2C
• Create B2B and B2C marketing campaigns and toolkits supporting new product launches, category scale phases, and partnerships
• Partner with the Logitech for Business team, central marketing team, channel partners, and regional marketing teams to implement integrated marketing campaigns
• Track and analyze business and marketing performance metrics, continuously optimizing for effectiveness and business objectives
• Define global portfolio strategy and key business drivers, own the financial and market performance analysis
• Build strong understanding of the target audience
• Own competitive & market intelligence and market trends assessment, be seen as a category expert and a go-to spokesperson, internally and externally
• Develop and evolve B2B and B2C new best practices and fit-for-use requirements

Key Qualifications

To be considered for this position you demonstrate:

• Experience in global brand and portfolio management roles with a strong innovation and consumer-centricity culture
• Strong command of Digital Marketing, Search and AEO/LLM optimization
• Experience with sales enablement and B2B-first launches is a big plus
• Experience of leading creative and production agencies on through-the-line global marketing campaign development, from briefing to creative development and production to toolkit assets creation
• Genuine passion for technology and innovation, with strong grasp of emerging technology trends
• Strong market, competitor, and business analysis skills, with portfolio management expertise and fluency in market data, competitive intelligence, and financial/business KPIs
• Demonstrated ability to operate in highly agile, fast-moving, multidisciplinary teams across cultures and time zones 
• Outcome-oriented self-starter with a strong sense of ownership and accountability, high degree of perseverance, ability to deal with ambiguity
• High degree of flexibility and ability to fluidly transition between business & marketing, strategic & operational tasks
• Fast learner, with a proven track record of creating scalable best practices
• Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders at all levels of the organization
• Fluent English

Across Logitech we empower collaboration and foster play. We help teams collaborate/learn from anywhere, without compromising on productivity or continuity so it should be no surprise that most of our jobs are open to work from home from most locations. Our hybrid work model allows some employees to work remotely while others work on-premises. Within this structure, you may have teams or departments split between working remotely and working in-house.

Logitech is an amazing place to work because it is full of authentic people who are inclusive by nature as well as by design. Being a global company, we value our diversity and celebrate all our differences. Don’t meet every single requirement? Not a problem. If you feel you are the right candidate for the opportunity, we strongly recommend that you apply. We want to meet you!

We offer comprehensive and competitive benefits packages and working environments that are designed to be flexible and help you to care for yourself and your loved ones, now and in the future. We believe that good health means more than getting medical care when you need it. On-site


Cork, Ireland or Lausanne, Switzerland


The Role 


As the Global Portfolio & Marketing Manager for New Ventures, PWS Business Group, you will play a central role in building and scaling new categories.


This role will drive global B2B & B2C portfolio and marketing strategy development and transform the assigned category by identifying portfolio gaps and growth opportunities, defining high-impact go-to-market strategies and new launch models, and creating effective marketing programs that drive growth.


Reporting to the Head of Business & Marketing for PWS New Ventures, this role requires being on-site 3 days a week as standard and flexibility to travel up to 20% of the time.


Your Impact 


Be Yourself. Be Open. Stay Hungry and Humble. Collaborate. Challenge. Decide and just Do. These are the behaviors you'll need for success at Logitech.

jobs.description:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.

Hybrid role - 2 days per week on site.

Sr. Procurement  Manager – Indirect Procurement

We are seeking an experienced and commercially driven Sr. Procurement  Manager to join our Indirect Procurement organization. In this role, you will act as a strategic partner to senior business leaders, including C-suite and executive stakeholders, helping shape how the organization manages third-party spend and creates sustainable business value.

You will own and lead strategic sourcing and category management initiatives across key areas of indirect spend, challenging established ways of working, identifying new opportunities, and bringing innovative procurement solutions to the business.

This role combines strategic thinking, commercial acumen, stakeholder influence, and strong execution. You will use market intelligence, data analytics, enterprise AI, and data storytelling to turn complex spend and market insights into clear recommendations and measurable outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Business Partnering & Stakeholder Influence

• Act as a trusted procurement advisor to C-suite and senior business leaders, providing strategic insights, commercial recommendations, and opportunities to optimize third-party spend.
• Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders across functions, developing a deep understanding of business priorities, challenges, and growth plans.
• Proactively challenge existing practices and assumptions, bringing external market perspectives, innovative solutions, and best-in-class procurement thinking to the organization.
• Influence decision-making at the highest levels, balancing business requirements, commercial objectives, risk, and long-term value.
• Partner with stakeholders to build procurement strategies that are aligned with broader business and functional objectives.

Category Management & Strategic Sourcing

• Develop and execute comprehensive category strategies across key indirect spend areas such as IT, Marketing, Professional Services, HR, Facilities, and other corporate services.
• Lead complex, high-value sourcing initiatives from opportunity identification and market analysis through to sourcing, negotiation, contracting, implementation, and benefits realization.
• Develop category roadmaps that identify opportunities for cost savings, cost avoidance, value creation, supplier optimization, risk mitigation, and process improvement.
• Lead cross-functional sourcing teams, bringing together business stakeholders, Finance, Legal, and other relevant functions to deliver strategic outcomes.
• Establish a strong understanding of supplier markets, emerging trends, cost drivers, and competitive dynamics to inform category strategies and sourcing decisions.
• Ensure sourcing and category initiatives deliver sustainable results that are tracked, measured, and communicated to stakeholders.

Data, AI & Procurement Transformation

• Leverage procurement data, analytics, and enterprise AI capabilities to identify opportunities, improve decision-making, and increase procurement effectiveness.
• Use data storytelling to translate complex spend, supplier, and market information into clear, compelling recommendations for senior stakeholders.
• Identify opportunities to automate, simplify, and transform procurement processes through technology, AI, and innovative ways of working.
• Establish fact-based business cases that demonstrate the financial and strategic impact of procurement initiatives.
• Contribute to the continued evolution of the Indirect Procurement function, helping establish scalable, data-driven, and digitally enabled ways of working.

Commercial Value & Supplier Management

• Lead complex commercial negotiations, ensuring procurement strategies deliver competitive pricing, favorable contractual terms, and broader business value.
• Develop and maintain strategic supplier relationships, balancing performance, innovation, commercial value, resilience, and risk.
• Identify opportunities to consolidate spend, improve supplier performance, optimize commercial models, and unlock additional value.
• Partner with Finance and business stakeholders to ensure savings and other procurement benefits are accurately measured, validated, and sustained.
• Monitor category and supplier performance, proactively addressing risks and identifying opportunities for continuous improvement.

Leadership & Procurement Excellence

• Lead through influence, bringing structure, pace, and accountability to complex, cross-functional initiatives.
• Mentor and support procurement colleagues, sharing category expertise, commercial best practices, and strategic sourcing capabilities.
• Represent Indirect Procurement as a strategic business function, promoting a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, and value creation.
• Contribute to procurement-wide initiatives and transformation programs beyond individual category responsibilities.

Job Description:

The Opportunity

DePuy Synthes is establishing a standalone Orthopaedics company. The planned separation is anticipated to be completed within 18 to 24 months of the original announcement in October 2025, subject to legal requirements, consultation with works councils and other employee representative bodies where required, regulatory approvals and other customary conditions.

Should you accept this position, it is anticipated that, following completion of the transaction, you would become an employee of DePuy Synthes, and your employment would be governed by DePuy Synthes employment processes, programmes, policies and benefit plans. Details of any planned changes would be shared at the appropriate time and subject to any necessary consultation processes.

As part of the planned separation, DePuy Ireland UC will assume Orthopaedics distribution activities from Johnson & Johnson’s MedTech business. These span distribution centres across Europe, the Middle East and Africa (EMEA), serving group companies and customers worldwide.

DePuy Synthes, a business of approximately $9 billion, is seeking a Senior Finance Manager within Supply Chain Finance to lead finance for these substantial added activities, combining financial leadership, business partnering and transformation delivery.

Your primary focus will be establishing the finance capabilities, resources and processes needed for these activities ahead of the April 2027 go-live.

Role Overview:

You will lead financial planning and analysis (FP&A), reporting and compliance, inventory finance, and capital expenditure finance for the added distribution activities, shaping the finance operating model and ensuring operational readiness.

You will partner with existing DePuy Ireland and MedTech distribution finance teams and regional and global colleagues across business unit and commercial finance, tax, shared services, audit and transformation. Following go-live, you will strengthen controls and drive continuous improvement and scalable finance capabilities.

Key Responsibilities:

Finance Team Development & Transition

• Recruit, onboard and develop the finance team for the added activities, defining clear roles, priorities and ways of working for go-live.

• Partner with existing MedTech and distribution finance teams on knowledge transfer and a smooth handover of processes and responsibilities.

• Build a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous learning and inclusion.

• Establish scalable, standardised finance processes using analytics and automation tools such as Alteryx, Power BI and Tableau. 

 

FP&A, Reporting & Compliance

• Build strong relationships with senior regional and global stakeholders across finance, commercial, tax and transformation, influencing decisions and aligning priorities to shape and deliver the finance operating model for the added activities.

• Establish and deliver forecasts for the added activities, drawing on existing processes and partnering with business unit finance, currency management and EMEA commercial finance.

• Lead budget-versus-actual analysis and executive reporting on gross profit performance for the added activities, including reporting for group sourcing companies.

• Oversee monthly and quarterly financial reporting and consolidation submissions for the added activities, providing accurate corporate and statutory inputs for quarterly and annual legal-entity reporting.

• Partner with the existing DePuy Ireland FP&A team to deliver consolidated legal-entity reporting, integrating added activities operating on a separate ERP from the entity’s existing operations.

• Implement reporting tools for the added activities with finance technology teams, aligned with consolidation systems, Anaplan and the future operating model.

DePuy Synthes, a ~$9 billion business, has an outstanding opportunity for a Senior Finance Manager operating within Supply Chain Finance to gain extensive exposure across DePuy Synthes Principal Operations while leading the Currency Management team.

Role Overview

In this role, you will provide financial leadership to the Currency Management team, leading the identification and management of foreign currency exposures, centralized hedging, hedge and inventory accounting, forecasting, analytics and reporting across DePuy Synthes.

You will play a critical role in standing up the group to operate as a standalone DePuy Synthes Principal Operations team, ensuring that essential currency management activities continue to be performed to the highest standards of compliance, accuracy and insight before, during and after separation.

The immediate focus of the role will be to stand up the Currency Management team and its operating model; establish the end-to-end exposure identification, hedge submission, accounting and control processes required to support placement of hedges through a third-party provider; and lead the development and ongoing maintenance of replacement calculation and analytics capabilities as existing systems will not be available to DePuy Synthes following separation.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead, coach and develop a global team of three finance professionals.
• Serve as the first point of contact for currency-related topics and questions across DePuy Synthes.
• Lead the identification and management of foreign currency exposures, including centralized forecasting and balance sheet hedging, and establish the process required to place hedges with a third-party provider.
• Ensure accurate and compliant hedge and inventory accounting in line with US GAAP and relevant accounting procedures.
• Lead the calculation, analysis, reporting and communication of actual and forecast transactional currency impacts across DePuy Synthes P&L lines, including driver-based variance analysis, trends, risks and opportunities.
• Provide currency analytics, insights and recommendations to DSPO, FP&A, Treasury and senior management.
• Lead regular currency and hedge-result reviews with business partners and senior leadership and provide training and educational materials to strengthen understanding of currency and hedging principles across DePuy Synthes.
• Lead the design, build, testing and deployment of a replacement tool to support currency calculations, hedging, analytics and reporting, and oversee its ongoing maintenance and enhancement.
• Drive standardized and efficient processes through automation and analytics tools, including Power BI and Alteryx.
• Partner across DSPO, Treasury, Tax, FP&A, Technology and Project Osprey teams to stand up the Currency Management team and ensure continuity of critical activities through separation.

Job Description:

 

DePuy Synthes is recruiting for a Sr. Manager, EMEA - SC Technology Logistics

Johnson & Johnson announced plans to separate our Orthopedics business to establish a standalone orthopedics company, operating as DePuy Synthes. The process of the planned separation is anticipated to be completed within 18 to 24 months, subject to legal requirements, including consultation with works councils and other employee representative bodies, as may be required, regulatory approvals and other customary conditions and approvals. Should you accept this position, it is anticipated that, following conclusion of the transaction, you would be an employee of DePuy Synthes and your employment would be governed by DePuy Synthes employment processes, programs, policies, and benefit plans. In that case, details of any planned changes would be provided to you by DePuy Synthes at an appropriate time and subject to any necessary consultation processes.

Job Overview

The Senior Manager, EMEA Supply Chain Technology - Logistics is the accountable technology leader for the DePuy Synthes EMEA Deliver domain. The role owns the regional Deliver technology roadmap and ensures that logistics technology capabilities are reliable, secure, compliant, scalable and aligned with DePuy Synthes business priorities, EMEA operational needs and global Supply Chain Technology strategies.

The role partners with regional and global Supply Chain, Deliver, Technology, Digital, Architecture, Finance, Quality, Procurement and external logistics providers to translate business strategy into an integrated portfolio of technology investments, operational improvements and transformation outcomes. The Senior Manager balances transformation delivery with uninterrupted business operations and clear accountability for value realisation.

 

Leadership Profile

A seasoned, strategic and pragmatic technology leader who combines business partnership with technical judgement, operational discipline and delivery accountability. The successful candidate is comfortable making trade-offs, creating clarity across organisational boundaries, developing talent and ensuring that transformation produces sustainable, measurable value without compromising service, compliance or continuity.

 

Key Responsibilities

Technology Strategy and Roadmap Ownership

·        Own and maintain the multi-year DePuy Synthes EMEA Deliver technology roadmap, aligned to the business strategy, network evolution, operational priorities and global technology direction.

·        Translate business capabilities and pain points into a prioritised, sequenced and funded portfolio with clear dependencies, decision points, risks and measurable outcomes.

·        Provide strategic direction across core logistics platforms, warehouse automation, data, integration and emerging digital capabilities.

Regional, Business Unit and Global Accountability

·        Serve as the primary technology partner for DePuy Synthes EMEA Deliver, with clear accountability for regional outcomes while operating within global product, platform, architecture, cybersecurity and compliance governance.

·        Clarify decision rights, ownership and handoffs across the regional business, DePuy Synthes, global Deliver, ERP and platform teams, and shared technology functions.

·        Represent EMEA priorities in global forums and ensure that global standards and roadmaps are adopted appropriately, with regional requirements and trade-offs made transparent.

Technology Ecosystem and Architecture

·        Provide end-to-end oversight of the EMEA Deliver technology ecosystem, including ERP, WMS, WCS/WES, TMS, warehouse automation, transportation, labelling, visibility, data and analytics, and internal and external integrations.

·        Partner with enterprise and solution architects to define target-state architecture, reduce fragmentation and technical debt, and ensure secure, scalable and supportable integration patterns.

jobs.description:
Ambition has no passport. That belief is why LemFi https://lemfi.com/en-gb/careers exists. We're the financial engine for people the world wasn't built to serve, the millions who move countries to build something better and find the financial system hasn't caught up with them yet. We started with remittances: the money people send home to the people they love. Now we run multi-currency accounts, Savings, eSIMs and Credit. Because staying connected to home and building somewhere new are not two separate things. They never were.

ABOUT THE ROLE

LemFi moves over $2B a month across 30+ countries for people who have built lives far from where they started. That makes us a target, in some of the most scrutinised payment corridors in the world, and attackers often go after the people and devices behind the product rather than the product itself. Here, security is an engineering problem first.
We're looking for a Senior Security Engineer in Dublin to own how we protect LemFi from the inside: every laptop, account, inbox and internal tool our teams rely on. You'll report directly to our CTO, build the controls, write the detections and run the incident when something gets through. It's a small team, so you'll write the playbook rather than follow one. There's compliance work at LemFi, but this seat is about stopping attackers and building controls, not running audits.

WHAT YOU'LL BUILD AND OWN

 - Endpoint protection across all laptops and devices: EDR, device management, hardening and patching, configured so a compromised device is caught fast and contained faster.

 - Identity and access across the company: SSO, MFA, privileged access, joiner and leaver flows, and access reviews that actually remove access.

 - Email, collaboration and SaaS security, including phishing defence and visibility into the internal tools our teams use every day.

 - Detection engineering and threat hunting across endpoint, identity and internal systems. Write the detections, tune out the noise, and hunt for what they miss.

 - Incident response from first alert through forensics and root cause to the change that closes the gap for good.

jobs.description:
Principal Infrastructure Security Engineer

Location: Dublin, IE

 

Ridgeline is hiring a Principal Infrastructure Security Engineer to set the direction for cloud and infrastructure security across every product line, account, and environment. You will define the architecture vision and the security invariants that guide engineering decisions, and you will be accountable for Ridgeline’s overall cloud security posture. 

You will work with Engineering, Product Management, and Technology leaders on cloud security trade-offs that carry business, regulatory, or reputational consequences. You will also help build the team's technical culture and develop Staff-level engineers, so that its standards, detection frameworks, and architectural judgment last beyond any single project. We believe in a culture where security is everyone's responsibility and an integral part of our engineering philosophy.

At Ridgeline, how we work matters as much as what we build. Ridgeliners act like owners, choose growth over comfort, and communicate with transparency. We assume positive intent, bias toward action, and bring solutions—not just problems. We celebrate wins, learn from setbacks, and thrive in a resilient, collaborative, high-performing culture.

If this excites you, we’d love to meet you.

You must be permitted to work in Ireland, including under EU work authorization, without the need for employer sponsorship.

What You’ll Do

• Own the multi-year cloud security architecture vision and the security invariants that govern engineering decisions across all product lines, AWS accounts, and infrastructure.

• Set the technical strategy for cloud security tooling and automation, including how AI changes security operations, and make the build-versus-buy decisions that determine what the team can do for years.

• Drive company-wide guardrails and controls in our AWS environment (e.g., SCPs, IAM boundaries, AWS managed security services, custom-built solutions, and policy-as-code), and implement the standards and processes that keep them enforced.

• Develop threat models and security approaches, and identify emerging threats to identity, data, AI workloads, and infrastructure before they become problems.

• Create frameworks and methodologies for securely integrating third-party cloud services and internal platforms, and see them adopted across Ridgeline.

• Anticipate broad changes in cloud and infrastructure security, identify where our current approach stops scaling, and propose fixes before it does.

• Build AI and automation frameworks, and partner across functions to deploy reusable agents that multiple teams use.

• Deliver large, cross-team projects on schedule and at high quality, breaking complex programs into pieces the contributing teams can execute.

• Build the cloud security team's long-term technical culture, develop Staff-level cloud security engineers, and sponsor the next leaders at Ridgeline.

• Shape C-suite and board-level decisions on cloud security investment, cloud adoption strategy, and organizational risk acceptance.

Who You Are & What Makes You Qualified:

• 10+ years of relevant experience in cloud security or platform engineering, including experience leading large cross-team initiatives with company-wide impact and delivering them on schedule.

• Advanced proficiency in at least one high-level language (Python strongly preferred; Kotlin or TypeScript a plus).

• Expert-level experience with AWS, especially in the following areas:

• Identity and Access Management (IAM, Orgs & SCPs, Identity Center)

• Networking (VPC, Security Groups, Transit Gateway, Load Balancers, Network Firewall)

• Compute (EKS, ECS, Lambda)

• Data Persistence (S3, Aurora, DynamoDB)

• Logging & Monitoring (GuardDuty, CloudTrail, CloudWatch)

• Demonstrated success defining enterprise-wide access management strategy and policy frameworks (IAM/SCPs), and cloud security architecture that engineering teams adopted.

• Deep understanding of cloud workload protection, infrastructure monitoring, and threat detection in AWS-native environments.

• Expert-level experience securing Kubernetes and Amazon EKS (including EKS Auto Mode): cluster access control, network policy, Istio service mesh, Kyverno admission policy, and image signing with cosign.

• Fluency with infrastructure-as-code (e.g., OpenTofu or Terraform), GitOps delivery (e.g., ArgoCD), and CI/CD practices, and experience setting tooling and automation strategy, including build-versus-buy decisions.

• Proven ability to present cloud security risk and trade-offs to executives, and to influence investment, cloud adoption, and risk acceptance decisions.

• Track record of anticipating broad change in cloud security and acting on it before it became urgent.

• Experience building AI or automation frameworks and reusable agents that change how cross-functional teams work.

• Experience developing senior engineers and sponsoring emerging leaders, and building team standards, detection frameworks, and architectural judgment that outlast individual projects.

Scopely is looking for a Senior Identity Security Engineer to join our Information Security team on a remote basis or hybrid basis if located in Barcelona.  This is a hands-on engineer who will build identity controls that reduce excessive privilege and protect critical operations. You will improve access across employee, player, business partner, and non-human identities by building AI-native identity workflows: agentic systems that handle provisioning, access reviews, and remediation within explicit guardrails, with humans approving what matters. Your work will protect the identities and access that support Scopely’s critical business processes, including essential enterprise functions and game operations.  This is a highly technical, hands-on role for someone who can operate across AWS, GCP, Okta, AWS IAM Identity Center, Zero Trust access models, identity governance workflows, and modern AI-enabled engineering environments, while building scalable identity systems through Infrastructure as Code, workflow orchestration, and automation-first security engineering.

What You Will Do

Reduce identity attack surface and privilege

• Reduce standing and excessive access with least-privilege roles, just-in-time and time-bound elevation, and automated access reviews.

• Build repeatable identity and access workflows that make onboarding, approvals, role changes, reviews, and offboarding consistent, traceable, and timely.

• Govern non-human identities, including service accounts, workload identities, CI/CD identities, API credentials, and AI agents and their tool integrations: inventory them, assign owners, replace long-lived secrets with short-lived or federated credentials, and rotate or revoke on a schedule and on signal.

Strengthen identity protection and resilience

• Protect access to critical business processes and systems with phishing-resistant authentication (passkeys/FIDO2), device trust and posture signals, tightly controlled privileged access, and prompt revocation of suspicious sessions or compromised credentials.

• Threat-model identity platforms, integrations, and access paths to identify exploitable trust relationships, privilege escalation, and credential misuse. 

• Build identity telemetry and response workflows to detect risky sign-ins, privilege changes, credential misuse, and compromised integrations. 

• Design and test break-glass and recovery procedures for identity services and cloud access so teams can regain secure access during an outage or compromise.

• Extend the same patterns to player and partner identities where security owns the controls: platform identity federation (Apple, Google, Steam, console), account linking and recovery, external and vendor access, and defenses against account takeover and credential stuffing.

Build AI-native identity services

• Build and operate reusable identity controls and services using infrastructure as code, APIs, scripting, and delivery pipelines. Apply code review, testing, drift detection, and audit trails so that every change, whether made by an engineer or an agent, is safe to deploy and easy to investigate.

• Design and build multi-agent workflows that surface identity risk, run access attestations, and triage and remediate access issues end to end. Engineer the harness those agents run in: scoped tools and permissions, curated context and data access, evals and test cases, orchestration between agents, and observability, so agent behavior is predictable, reviewable, and improvable.

• Treat agents as identities. Give every agent and MCP integration its own scoped credentials, least-privilege permissions, and bounded data access; validate inputs and outputs; log every action; and require human approval for changes that touch privileged access or production.

• Work with game and platform stakeholders to adopt shared identity patterns. Measure progress through reduced standing privilege, stale access, and unmanaged identities, and less manual work.

• Produce audit-ready evidence for access reviews, privileged access, and lifecycle events as a byproduct of the workflows rather than a separate project.

What You Bring

• 5+ years of experience in IAM, or identity-focused cloud/security engineering, including hands-on ownership of production identity controls in complex environments.

• Strong experience with Okta or a comparable workforce identity platform and AWS/GCP IAM, as well as federation and provisioning protocols such as SAML, OIDC, OAuth, and SCIM.

• Production experience building, testing, and operating identity services or automation using Terraform or comparable infrastructure as code, Python, Go, or TypeScript., APIs, version control, and CI/CD.

• Strong knowledge of least privilege, just-in-time privileged access, identity lifecycle and governance, authentication controls, and non-human or workload identity risk.

• Experience threat-modeling identity architectures, integrations, and access paths, and driving remediation with service owners.
