jobs.title: Global Customer Supply Chain Transformation Manager (12-months contract)
jobs.experience: 5+ years mentioned (check advert)
jobs.description:
Logitech is the Sweet Spot for people who want their actions to have a positive global impact while having the flexibility to do it in their own way.

Location: Utrecht, Netherlands or Cork, Ireland

Working Model: Hybrid (2-3 days/week)

The Team and Role:

At Logitech, Customer Supply Chain (CSC) plays a critical role in delivering an outstanding customer experience while enabling sustainable business growth. As our organization continues to evolve, Global CSC Transformation is focused on accelerating business capabilities, driving process excellence, enabling digital innovation and fostering collaboration across our Global CSC network. 

As the Global CSC Transformation Manager, you will play a pivotal role in supporting and executing the transformation agenda for Global Customer Supply Chain. Working closely with Regional CSC Heads, you will lead strategic, cross-functional initiatives that improve operational excellence, strengthen customer collaboration, accelerate digital and AI adoption, and enhance the capabilities of our global CSC organization.

This is a highly collaborative role that requires exceptional stakeholder management and influencing skills. You will partner with Global & Regional CSC Heads, and cross-functional stakeholders across Planning, Commercial, IT, Digital, Data & Analytics and Finance to align priorities, drive execution and deliver meaningful business outcomes. Success in this role depends on your ability to build trusted relationships, influence without direct authority and navigate a highly matrixed global environment.

Beyond delivering transformation initiatives, you will proactively identify opportunities to improve processes, simplify ways of working and introduce innovative solutions that create measurable value for both the business and our customers. You will contribute to the continuous evolution of Global CSC capabilities while helping embed a culture of innovation, collaboration and continuous improvement across the organization.

Your Contribution:

Be Yourself. Be Open. Stay Hungry and Humble. Collaborate. Challenge. Decide and just Do. Share our passion for Equality and the Environment. These are the behaviors and values you’ll need for success at Logitech. In this role you will:

• 

Drive strategic transformation initiatives by leading end-to-end business process redesign (BPR) and evolving operating models to simplify, standardize and optimize the Global Customer Supply Chain organization.

• 

Drive customer-centric transformation by improving customer journey, service experience and cross-functional collaboration across the order-to-cash process. 

• 

Building strong partnerships with Global and Regional CSC Heads and cross-functional stakeholders to align priorities and deliver business outcomes.

• 

Identifying opportunities to simplify processes, improve ways of working and accelerate organizational capabilities.

• 

Leading cross-functional initiatives that enable digital transformation, AI adoption and process standardization.

• 

Translating business needs into actionable transformation plans and ensuring successful execution and adoption.

• 

Establish governance, KPIs and benefits realization frameworks to monitor progress and transformation value.

• 

Promoting collaboration, innovation and continuous improvement across the Global CSC organization.

• 

Contributing to the development of scalable capabilities that enhance customer experience, operational excellence and long-term business growth.

Key Qualifications:

For consideration, you must bring the following minimum skills and experiences to our team:

• 

Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain, Engineering, Operations Management or a related field.

• 

5+ years of experience in Business Transformation, Program Management, Supply Chain, Customer Supply Chain, Consulting or related functions.

• 

Project Management and/or Change Management certification (e.g., PMP, Agile, Prosci)with excellent project and program management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.

• 

Experience leading complex cross-functional digital transformation initiatives, including process automation and AI-enabled business improvements, in a global matrixed organization. 

• 

Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building skills, with the ability to influence across functions and organizational levels without direct authority.

• 

Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights and business recommendations.

• 

Excellent communication, presentation and executive storytelling skills.

• 

Strong financial acumen with experience developing business cases, establishing governance and KPIs, and measuring transformation success through ROI and benefits realization.

• 

Demonstrated experience supporting organizational change and driving adoption of new processes, tools or ways of working.

• 

Self-starter with a continuous improvement mindset, strong ownership and the ability to navigate ambiguity.

• 

Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, particularly PowerPoint and Excel.

• 

Fluent

jobs.description:
Are you looking for a unique opportunity to be a part of something great? Want to join a 17,000-member team that works on the technology that powers the world around us? Looking for an atmosphere of trust, empowerment, respect, diversity, and communication? How about an opportunity to own a piece of a multi-billion dollar (with a B!) global organization? We offer all that and more at Microchip Technology Inc.

People come to work at Microchip because we help design the technology that runs the world. They stay because our culture supports their growth and stability. They are challenged and driven by an incredible array of products and solutions with unlimited career potential. Microchip’s nationally-recognized Leadership Passage Programs support career growth where we proudly enroll over a thousand people annually. We take pride in our commitment to employee development, values-based decision making, and strong sense of community, driven by our Vision, Mission, and 11 Guiding Values; we affectionately refer to it as the Aggregate System and it’s won us countless awards for diversity and workplace excellence.

Our company is built by dedicated team players who love to challenge the status quo; we did not achieve record revenue and over 30 years of quarterly profitability without a great team dedicated to empowering innovation. People like you.

Visit our careers page to see what exciting opportunities and company perks await!

Job Description:

Position Summary

As a Manufacturing Engineer, you will be a key member of the site engineering team, responsible for ensuring that our high-reliability discrete semiconductor products meet stringent customer, industry, and regulatory requirements. You will own product and process definition through part requirement analysis and test flow selection, ensuring products are correctly processed through electrical screening and sampling operations in accordance with applicable military, aerospace, and internal specification test methods.

You will develop and maintain robust process controls, drive automation initiatives, and contribute to continuous improvement in yield, quality, throughput, and cost of ownership.

The Manufacturing Engineering team in Ennis comprises two disciplines: electrical and mechanical. This position focuses on electrical engineering support for the site, including back-end test and reliability screening operations.

Working Pattern

This is a day shift position. The successful candidate will work Monday - Friday, 08:00 – 16:30.

Why Join Us

You will receive structured in-house training and be coached and mentored by senior engineers with deep expertise in high-reliability semiconductor manufacturing — an excellent platform to build a career in a specialized, high-value segment of the industry.

Role Focus

• Lead and support project work on high-reliability screening operations, including High Temperature Reverse Bias (HTRB), burn-in, and electrical test/screening methodologies.
• Partner with site engineers on equipment appraisal and qualification initiatives, driving process standardization, quality improvement, and Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS) enhancements.
• Develop deep knowledge of products, processes, and test equipment to provide technical direction on product disposition through screening and sampling process steps.
• Ensure compliance with applicable industry test methods, standards, and customer source-control requirements.

Key Responsibilities

• Apply reliability engineering theory and principles (e.g., failure mechanisms, acceleration models, screening effectiveness) to Microchip products and manufacturing processes.
• Drive data analysis, statistical process control (SPC), and root cause / corrective action (RCCA) activities to resolve yield, quality, and equipment issues and to sustain continuous improvement.
• Originate and develop technical solutions, process advancements, and automation initiatives that strengthen Microchip's position as an industry leader in high-reliability discrete semiconductors.
• Create and maintain process and product documentation, including test flows, specifications, and associated process controls.

Requirements/Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree (Level 8) in Engineering or Physics; Electronic/Electrical Engineering preferred.
• Exposure to continuous improvement and quality methodologies — Lean, Six Sigma, 5S, DOE, DMAIC, FMEA, SPC — is an advantage.
• Familiarity with semiconductor device physics, discrete power devices (e.g., diodes and bipolar transistors), or ATE/electrical test environments is an advantage but not essential.

Essential Skills and Attributes

• Strong grasp of electrical engineering fundamentals and semiconductor device behavior.
• Demonstrated ability to learn, retain, and apply detailed product and process knowledge.
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail.
• Effective written and verbal communica

jobs.description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title and Summary

Senior Principal, Software Architect | Global Open Finance

Overview: 

Mastercard’s Open Finance team is seeking a Senior Principal, Software Architect to define and drive the architecture that enables this vision. Job Function: 

Supply Chain Engineering

Job Sub Function: 

Manufacturing Engineering

Job Category:

Scientific/Technology

All Job Posting Locations:

Limerick, Ireland

Job Description:

Job Position Summary

The Staff Manufacturing Engineer is a senior individual-contributor role providing technical leadership for manufacturing engineering within J&J Vision Care, Limerick. Working in a high-volume, fully automated and highly regulated contact lens manufacturing environment, the Staff Engineer leads complex, high-impact technical initiatives that improve equipment performance, process capability, yield and output, while ensuring operations remain safe, compliant and cost-effective.

The role acts as a subject matter expert and technical authority across one or more value streams, influences technical direction across Engineering, Operations, Quality, R&D and Global Engineering, and coaches and mentors engineers to raise the technical capability of the wider team. The Staff Engineer reports to the Manufacturing Engineering Manager and has no direct line management responsibility, but is expected to lead through influence.

Duties & Responsibilities

Technical Leadership

• Act as the senior technical authority for manufacturing equipment and processes, providing direction on complex troubleshooting, root cause analysis and long-term technical solutions.
• Lead the design, installation, qualification, optimisation and standardisation of lens production processes, equipment, tooling and controls, ensuring solutions are scalable and, where appropriate, deployed across multiple lines and value streams.
• Drive year-on-year improvements in equipment OEE, process capability, yield and output through structured problem solving, data analysis and Lean / Six Sigma methodologies.
• Develop and maintain technical roadmaps for assigned platforms, including obsolescence and aged-asset mitigation, technology upgrades and capability development.
• Provide technical input to capital investment proposals, business cycle planning and cost-saving programmes.

Projects, NPI & Continuous Improvement

• Lead large, cross-functional engineering projects from concept through design, installation, commissioning, validation and ramp-up, including new product introductions (NPI), line conversions and capacity expansion.
• Identify and lead cost, quality and technical improvement initiatives under the site continuous improvement programme, quantifying benefits and delivering to agreed timelines and budgets.
• Apply robust project management governance, providing timely and accurate status reporting to stakeholders and leadership.
• Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends, and introduce those that deliver a measurable benefit to safety, quality, delivery and cost.

Quality, Compliance & EHS

• Ensure all engineering activities conform to corporate, franchise, statutory and regulatory requirements for GMP, EHS and Quality, including change control, equipment qualification and process validation.
• Own or support effective closure of Quality System actions such as CAPAs, non-conformances, audit actions and risk assessments.
• Embed safety and environmental requirements in the purchase, modification and operation of new and existing equipment, including machine safety standards.
• Create, review and approve technical documentation, including specifications, protocols, work instructions and troubleshooting guides.
• Act as a subject matter expert during internal and external audits.

Collaboration, Coaching & Culture

• Partner with Operations, Quality, R&D, Supply Chain, Strategic Sourcing and Global Engineering to deliver value stream safety, quality, delivery and cost objectives.
• Build relationships with other J&J sites, equipment vendors and external experts to share best practice and leverage learnings.
• Mentor and coach Associate, Manufacturing and Senior Engineers, supporting their technical and career development.
• Role-model Our Credo and JJVC behavioural standards, and contribute to a high-performance, inclusive team culture.
• Support the Engineering Manager in developing and implementing strategic engineering goals and objectives.
• All employees are responsible for minim

Senior Manufacturing Engineer, J&J, Vision, Limerick, Ireland 

This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced Senior Manufacturing Engineer to support manufacturing performance, process capability, equipment reliability, and continuous improvement within a fast-paced, highly automated, and regulated manufacturing environment.

In this role, you will provide strong engineering support across manufacturing operations, helping to improve process capability, equipment performance, quality, and output. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to troubleshoot issues, deliver engineering projects, and implement practical, compliant solutions that support safe, efficient, and reliable manufacturing.

As Senior Manufacturing Engineer, you will:

− Support the deployment of manufacturing and automation solutions that improve process capability, equipment performance, quality, and output within assigned manufacturing areas.

− Support the design, installation, qualification, optimisation, and improvement of manufacturing processes, equipment, tooling, and controls.

− Provide troubleshooting support for process and equipment issues using structured problem-solving, data analysis, and sound engineering judgement.

− Partner with operations, quality, maintenance, validation, supply chain, and other engineering teams to implement robust and compliant manufacturing solutions.

− Identify and deliver continuous improvement initiatives that enhance yield, reduce cost, increase capacity, and improve manufacturing performance.

− Lead or support technical projects from concept through implementation, ensuring clear execution, risk management, and timely communication of progress and outcomes.

− Ensure timely and effective completion of Quality System deliverables including CAPAs, non-conformances, audit actions, change controls, and associated technical documentation.

− Ensure safety, environmental, and regulatory requirements are fully integrated into the design, purchase, modification, and operation of new and existing manufacturing equipment.

− Support plant and engineering strategic initiatives by bringing technical expertise, urgency, and execution focus to critical business priorities.

− Champion a culture of environmental, health, and safety excellence by ensuring all activities are carried out responsibly and in full compliance with site and company expectations.

Essential:

− A bachelor’s degree in Manufacturing, Mechanical, Industrial, Process, Automation, or a related Engineering discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

− Minimum of 4 years’ engineering experience in a regulated manufacturing environment, with demonstrated capability in troubleshooting, process improvement, and project delivery.

− The ability to take ownership, work independently, and deliver results in a fast-paced manufacturing setting.

− Strong communication, teamwork
